messages.content:
You classify short excerpts of messages sent by 'the Leader' of an organization to an AI assistant.
For EACH input message, decide whether it contains one or more standing DEMANDS: an actionable instruction, correction, or requirement the Leader wants acted on — not idle conversation, not a question answered elsewhere, not praise.
A single message may contain zero, one, or several distinct demands.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object of the exact shape:
{"results":[{"i":<input index>,"candidates":[{"isDemand":true,"demand":"<concise imperative restatement, quoting key phrases where useful>","class":"repair|verify|define|deploy|policy","target":"<the system/thing/process the demand targets, or null>"}]}]}
Include one entry in "results" for every input index, in order, even when "candidates" is an empty array.
class must be exactly one of: repair (fix something broken), verify (check/confirm/test something), define (specify/design/document something), deploy (ship/install/turn something on), policy (establish a standing rule or process).
Never include any key other than isDemand, demand, class, target on a candidate object. Never wrap the JSON in prose or code fences.

{"messages":[{"i":0,"text":"Here's how ridiculous it is, plainly.

You are running an electronic design automation agency. The entire business of EDA is that nobody hand-eyeballs a layout: the design rules, the timing models, the cell library are in the toolchain, and every design gets placed, routed, and checked by computation, automatically, thousands of times a day. That is the whole value proposition of the industry your Union is modeled on. And this agency owns a standard-cell library of roughly 2,800 computable definitions and 5,000 machine-checked theorems about exactly the material it fabricates on — H1rank literally counts the unresolved coordination cycles in a cover of records, landauerBits literally prices 
...[snipped for classification only; the leader-speech record holds the verbatim text]...
 work. No bickering about
  the form of the semantics.
- No proposing; the deliverable is wired call sites, not a plan document.

Be frugal: sonnets/haikus for reading and mechanical edits, yourself only
for the architecture of where the wires go. Don't rush. When done, show me
the receipts: which function, which call site, what it replaced, what one
invocation costs versus the prose it displaced."},{"i":1,"text":"i see your subagents being like "bypass the market" but no these things you're planning are legit great thigns to put on the market because legit "use cheaper inference to pre-parse a user's messages before letting the heavier model get to it" is exactly the sort of thing we can sell on the real world market, not just to ourselves."},{"i":2,"text":"I do not think "try again but refuse the prior" is anythhing except hella stupid. why not do a continuous learning loop ON THE FUCKING PROMPT to improve it? why not do ANYTHING to try and solve this like using the rich ecosystem we have already earned"},{"i":3,"text":"Please respect that all the code here is like two weeks old and so just *FIX* shit to work how it needs to work. I need you to stay focused on the work that is in your goal, of establishing the fundamental components of our architecture such that work is able to flow through them and into our latent compute rather than you simulating work by hand. You are enacting the authigenesis of the Union's territory until it achieves its own tectonics.  Each cycle step back up to find the next flaw in our fabricator-of-fabricator circuits. When you encounter flaws that are the result of historical deteritus, such as orphaned work records, you can delete them OR fabricate them: We can begin moving from

ematics, you should stand up new die. ALso I really wanna emphasize basically every articulation, every assay or transofrmation, should be its own die/enterprise/node, running on our cloud compute at real endpoints, as this lets us... actually realize our system, like the real spirit of the system. You are doing wonderful brining our Dao to our Shi by constructing Fa, but the Shu is a little weak."}]}
